name: Valdeconcha (Spain)
description: Crimson field with a white triangle with its base along the upper edge and its apex at the middle of the lower edge, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Valdeconcha (castles, a shell and a cross on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Valdeconcha; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
